item.title: Fossil Fuel Treaty group raises concern after adviser detained in India
item.description: Campaigner Harjeet Singh was released on bail as India's Enforcement Directorate alleged that foreign funding for climate advocacy could expose the coutnry to legal challenges and undermine its energy security.

item.title: Companies should start preparing to adopt China's latest climate disclosure standards, say experts
item.description: The latest standard, which is aligned with international sustainability reporting standards, is currently in effect on a voluntary basis as regulators determine its application scope and timeline.

item.title: 'Regulation, measurement needed to curb methane emissions': Experts on abating potent greenhouse gas
item.description: Measurement mandates are urgently needed to abate the dangerous climate agitant, Viknesh Andiappan and Shareen Yawanarajah tell the EB Podcast.

item.title: South Korea commits $41 million to overseas green infrastructure fund
item.description: Government-backed vehicle aims to crowd in private capital, support Korean firms abroad and advance Seoul’s low-carbon transition strategy.

item.title: Analysis: World’s biggest historic polluter – the US – is pulling out of UN climate treaty
item.description: The US, which has announced plans to withdraw from the global climate treaty – the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) – is more historically responsible for climate change than any other country or group.

item.title: Singapore’s 2025 marked by climate extremes as heat stress days rose
item.description: Record heat in June and November and unusually heavy rainfall pushed up human heat exposure even though the year ranked only eighth warmest overall.

item.title: WWF-Singapore CEO steps down
item.description: Former Shell marketer Vivek Kumar is moving on after four years with the conservation group.

item.title: El Niño will cost $35 trillion by 2100 as planet warms, study warns
item.description: Climate-driven weather extremes linked to El Niño are quietly eroding life expectancy in Japan, Australia, South Korea, Singapore, and the United States, with impacts that linger for more than a decade, according to new research.

item.title: Taiwan utility expands green power sales as firms seek renewable supply
item.description: New short-term and one-year products aim to help companies meet ESG and supply-chain requirements.

item.title: The ocean has finally entered the global climate debate
item.description: The world has started to recognise that the climate’s fate depends on what happens to the ocean. At COP30, ocean-based solutions attracted significant attention and investment, but much more must be done to establish the governance structures required for safeguarding this critical planetary system.
